text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. 1 Shout to YHWH, all the earth.
Serve YHWH with gladness! Come before His face with a shout of joy!
Know that YHWH, He [is] God; He has made us and not we ourselves; [we are] His people and the sheep of His pasture.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise; give thanks to Him; bless His name!
For YHWH [is] good; forever [is] His loving devotion, and unto generation and generation His faithfulness.
